about.heading: About me
about.photoAlt: Gemma, the developer behind Past Nine
paragraphs: I'm Gemma, the developer behind Past Nine — a one-woman web studio building fast, clean sites and web apps with Next.js, Tailwind, and TypeScript.

I work directly with clients, end to end — from first idea through to a site that's fast, well-built, and actually easy to maintain. No handoffs, no account managers, just one person who cares about getting it right.
Based in New Zealand, working with clients wherever they are.
